period: requests filed 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Aug 2026; pages read 14 Oct 2026
definition: Share of sampled hand-off closures (20 largest hand-off type x closing-phrase pairs) whose public status page shows one or more attached inspections or work orders
label: observed
note: any attached item, not necessarily a work order
derivation: 100 of 800 sampled hand-off pages had a totalItem counter above zero; Wilson 95% interval; weighted share uses each pair's population
